Official Overture release2026-10-21.0 Parquet metadata, captured with the existing If-Match/strong-ETag range transport. Source asset and SHA256 in identity.json. Sources: https://stac.overturemaps.org/2026-10-21.0/places/place/collection.json and https://overturemaps.org/ . This fixture contains schema, offsets and row-group statistics, not a current place inventory. Copyright/licensing of the original release remains with its listed contributors. No live network is used in this test. The synthetic zero pages do not prove valid place rows; existing full native prefetch tests verify real data-page/query equivalence.
